changelog.change: Member profiles can create a new card with the member already selected.
Member relation labels resolve through People instead of blank legacy identity fields.
Selected unpublished relations remain visible so historical references are preserved.
Card lists display People-backed member names.
Fixed the administrator member page crash caused by an undefined HtmlView getDatabase() call.
Current-card lookup now runs through RecordModel while Cards remains the authoritative source.
No membership or card data is rewritten by this patch.
Cards is now the authoritative source for card numbers and card lifecycle data.
The member form no longer duplicates an editable card number.
Member profiles show the current card in read-only form and link to Cards management.
Legacy member card-number data is preserved without destructive migration.
Legacy members with a blank prior status no longer receive invented lifecycle dates when their current status is first set.
New members still receive normal automatic lifecycle dates and member records explicitly default to Published.
Existing historical data is preserved without automatic rewriting.
New publishable Membership records now default to Published.
Category creation no longer starts with state 0 by default.
Administrator lists display Published/Unpublished labels instead of raw numeric state values.
Ordered configurable entities now default to ordering 0 instead of saving NULL.
Category creation works without manually entering an ordering value.
The same safe ordering default applies to case statuses and checklist templates.
Required configurable member categories with optional stable category code.
Configurable default member status and safe manual/optional automatic member numbering.
Lifecycle date defaults for admission, activation, status changes and cessation.
Categories added to the administrator submenu with missing-category guidance in the member form.
Organizations picker with parent-child hierarchy and readable indentation.
Live search by organization name, hierarchy path and translated type.
Organization type translations added for Italian, English and French.
Membership lifecycle dates, rights and non-destructive history.
Public person-memberships and eligibility services for People integration.
Transfer effective date with controlled destination update on completion.

changelog.note: Integrazione opzionale con Finance 1.3.0 tramite servizio pubblico: aggiornamenti prima dell'allocazione, replay idempotente e rifiuto delle modifiche conflittuali dopo l'allocazione.
Integrazione condivisa con Notifications, Tasks e Analytics, reminder pianificati e conservazione dei dati Membership esistenti.
Core integration migrata al namespace canonico xdecaro\Core con Core 1.3.0+ richiesto soltanto per le funzioni Core; fallback locale invariato.
Package release con integrazione UI opzionale Core by xdecaro 1.1+, fallback locale e infrastruttura di aggiornamento.
